app.name: Ahabby
app.tagline: One place for every AI coding agent on your machine

agents.title: Agents
agents.emptyHint: Ahabby did not find any of the agents it knows about. Add a search path in Settings if yours live somewhere unusual.
agents.emptyAvailableHint: Every known agent is already installed on this machine.
agents.unverifiedHint: Some paths of this manifest have not been confirmed against the official documentation yet.
agents.problemsHint: One or more manifests could not be loaded. The affected agent is not listed.

agent.notFound: This agent is not in the catalog any more.
agent.notInstalledHint: Ahabby knows how to manage this agent, but the executable is not on this machine.

configs.title: Configuration files
configs.noneHint: The manifest of this agent does not declare any configuration file yet.
configs.notEditable: This file is declared read-only by the manifest.
configs.truncated: The file is too large to edit here ({{size}}). Open it in your editor instead.

editor.validationFailed: The file does not parse as {{format}} and will not be written.
editor.staleFile: This file changed on disk since you opened it.
editor.staleHint: Reload it to see the current content, then reapply your edit.
editor.restoreBody: The current content of {{file}} will be replaced by the backup from {{when}}. A backup of the current content is taken first.

skills.title: Global skills
skills.noneHint: Skills appear here once the agent has a skills directory with SKILL.md files.
skills.name: Name
skills.noContent: This skill has no markdown body.
skills.deleteBody: The directory {{path}} will be moved to the system trash — you can restore it from there. Nothing is deleted permanently.
skills.notRemovable: Ahabby will not delete this one

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.noneHint: Add servers with the agent's own CLI, or edit its config file here.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.deleteBody: The entry will be deleted from {{config}}. A timestamped backup is taken first, so you can undo this from Backups.

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Everything installed across your agents
library.emptyHint: Install an agent, or point Ahabby at your skills directory in Settings.

install.title: Run command
install.confirmBody: Ahabby will run exactly this command from the agent's manifest. Nothing else is executed, and you can cancel at any time.
install.managerMissing: {{manager}} is not installed on this machine.
install.managerMissingHint: Install it first, or follow the official instructions instead.
install.uninstallHint: This command is destructive: it removes the agent from your machine.
install.noMethods: No install method is available for this platform.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Applies to the whole interface immediately.
settings.scanPathsHint: Extra directories that are searched when looking for agent executables.
settings.networkChecksHint: Queries the npm registry or GitHub releases of the agents you have installed. Never sends any personal data. Scans work fine without it.
settings.backupDirHint: Every write to a config file is backed up here with a timestamp. Leave empty to use the default location.
settings.catalogDirHint: Drop extra agent manifests (TOML) here. A file with the same id overrides the built-in one.
settings.managersNone: None found — installs and updates will be unavailable.
settings.aboutText: Ahabby reads the configuration of your AI coding agents. It never sends your files anywhere, and every write is backed up first.

errors.no_install_method: No install method for this platform
